# IgnittoMedia
> Video production studio helping founders, creators, and businesses engineer attention through world-class video editing.

IgnittoMedia transforms raw footage into content that builds authority, earns trust, and drives measurable growth. We don't edit videos. We engineer attention.

## Services

- **Short Form Video Editing** — High-retention vertical content engineered for algorithmic growth on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
- **Long Form Video Editing** — Documentaries, YouTube essays, and deep-dive content that retains viewers for 20+ minutes.
- **Commercial Video Production** — High-end brand narratives and advertising campaigns that convert.
- **Podcast Production** — Multi-cam switching, color grading, and audio mastering for professional shows.
- **Motion Graphics** — Custom animations, UI mockups, and visual effects that explain complex ideas.
- **Creative Direction** — Thumbnails, hooks, and complete visual strategy designed to maximize CTR.

## Process

1. Upload & Ideation — You drop raw footage into our portal; we strategize the optimal narrative hook and pacing.
2. Editorial Engineering — Frame-by-frame cuts, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
3. Review & Refinement — Collaborative rounds with precise, fast revisions.
4. Delivery & Scale — Final exports in all required formats, ready to publish.

## Why IgnittoMedia

- 100+ projects delivered
- 20M+ views generated across client channels
- 96% client retention rate
- 48-hour average turnaround
